It also says GLM serves only through embedded MTP, with mtp_mode=off or DARKBLOOM_CBV2_MTP=0 skipping the model, and that this is no qualification or memory-admission bypass. No threat-model assumption is invalidated, and no new trust boundary is visible: no TB-002 coordinator exposure, no attestation or authorization change, and no prefix-cache (T-041) change. A later pass should check, if that code appears, that the JSON path and manifest pinning are validated (absolute path, owner-only, no symlink following) and that the local-only gating holds.
